Definition: from G5456; to emit a sound (animal, human or instrumental); by implication, to address in words or by name, also in imitation:--call (for), crow, cry.
BiblicalUsage: Phoneo means to call, to cry out, to make a sound, and it is the verb of calling in the gospels. Martha goes her way and calls Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee, the cock crows while Peter is still denying the Lord, and the shepherd calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that calling is how the gospel works: the Master calls for Mary, the cock calls Peter to himself, and the shepherd calls each sheep by name.
